command:
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "== step 1: create dedicated system account =="
if ! id inventorysvc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n addgroup -S inventorysvc
  sudo -n adduser -S -D -H -h /nonexistent -s /sbin/nologin -G inventorysvc inventorysvc
fi
id inventorysvc

echo "== step 2: write OpenRC service =="
sudo -n tee /etc/init.d/inventory-worker >/dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/sbin/openrc-run

name="inventory-worker"
description="OS comparison worker managed service"
command="/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker"
command_user="inventorysvc:inventorysvc"
command_background=true
pidfile="/run/${RC_SVCNAME}.pid"
output_log="/var/log/inventory-worker.log"
error_log="/var/log/inventory-worker.log"

depend() {
	need net
}
EOF
sudo -n chmod 755 /etc/init.d/inventory-worker

echo "== step 3: ensure log ownership =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-worker.log
sudo -n chown inventorysvc:inventorysvc /var/log/inventory-worker.log

echo "== step 4: enable and start =="
sudo -n rc-update add inventory-worker default
sudo -n rc-service inventory-worker start

sleep 2

echo "== step 5: verify =="
sudo -n rc-service inventory-worker status
echo "-- process owner --"
ps aux | grep '[o]s-comparison-worker'
echo "-- pidfile --"
cat /run/inventory-worker.pid 2>/dev/null || true
